description: This file defines the Termynal class, a JavaScript component for creating animated terminal-like interfaces with features like typing animation, progress bars, and controls for restarting or fast-forwarding the animation.

classes.name: Termynal
classes.description: A class that creates and manages an animated terminal widget with typing and progress animations.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the Termynal widget with container and options.

methods.name: loadLines
methods.description: Loads and prepares lines for animation.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the widget, clears container, and starts animation.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins the animation sequence, rendering lines based on their data attributes.

methods.name: generateFinish
methods.description: Creates a finish control element for fast-forward.

methods.name: lineDataToElements
methods.description: Converts line data objects into DOM elements.

methods.name: _attributes
methods.description: Generates attribute string for line data objects.
